simple.summary: שָׁסַס (shâçaç) means to plunder First listed occurrence: 1Sam 17 53.

definitions.full: H8155. shasas [ שָׁסַס ] verb id. (|| from of שׁסה ); — Qal Perfect 3plural שַׁסֻּ֫הוּ Psa 89:42 they have plundered him; Imperfect 3masculine plural וַיָּשֹׁ֫סּוּ Judg 2:14 (accusative of person); 1Sam 17:53 (accusative of location); participle suffix שֹׁאֲסַיִךְ Jer 30:16 Kt (Qr see שׁסה ), Aramaic form, Ges § 67s . Niph`al be plundered, rifled , of houses: Perfect 3plural consecutive וְנָשַׁ֫סּוּ Zech 14:2 ; Imperfect 3masculine plural יִשַּׁ֫סּוּ Isa 13:16 .
